target_customer: Teams that need internal tools and dashboards on top of their databases and third-party services; the later site pitches BI tools
problem: Building internal tools is slow. Olive generates full-stack internal tools from natural language by reading the database schema and writing queries.
business_model: B2B SaaS; waitlist at launch, pricing not found
product_category: AI internal tool and BI builder

founders.name: Bardia Safari
previous_startups: Fundsy (fiscal sponsorship and financial services platform)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; the founders have known each other since high school.

founders.name: Shrey Gupta
education: UC Davis, computer science (YC page lists as dropout; launch post says Ex-UC Davis)

exit.reason: YC lists Inactive; no shutdown, pivot or acquisition report found, and the site (which mentions the $2.1M seed) appeared active.

technical_complexity.rationale: Schema introspection, safe query generation and deployment of full-stack tools is standard LLM engineering with hard security and governance parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many prompt-to-app and AI BI tools existed, and Olive had no disclosed data or integration lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI app and dashboard builders; no acquisition of Olive was found.

market_need_then: The launch post cites dissatisfaction with existing providers for building dashboards; AI app builder demand rose through 2024 and 2025, but no usage numbers were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses fromolive.com, a prefix domain, since olive.com was not theirs.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain: 'Build fast, secure BI tools with AI'

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared with Olive AI (a 2023 health tech shutdown) and many olive oil brands, so searches return unrelated results.

pivots.why: not stated; the launch post says internal tools while the company site tagline says BI tools, so the shift is inferred from wording and the date is unknown

outcome_analysis: Olive entered YC in Winter 2025 with two returning co-founders from Fundsy and raised a reported $2.1M seed, which is large relative to other recent small batches. Its positioning drifted from internal tools toward BI tools and it faced many funded competitors, but YC now lists it Inactive with no public cause, so the reason it stalled is unknown.
notes: The seed amount comes from the company's own YC job listing (no date given) and is repeated by Standout and Employbl; investor names come from aggregators in the search summary only, so they rest on aggregators. The round date is unknown. Competitors left empty: the launch post names no rivals and the tool comparisons found are dated 2026 or undated. The pivot is inferred from wording and may not be a real pivot. Not related to Olive AI, the health tech company. Cause of Inactive status not found.
